 =\min\left\{1,\frac{h_{\mathrm{RW}}(\Phi,p)}{\chi(\Phi,p)}\right\}.$$ No separation assumption is required; exact overlaps and repeated generators are allowed.

Let $m\ge2$, $0<\lambda<1$, and $t_1,\ldots,t_m\in\mathbb R$. If the maps $x\mapsto\lambda x+t_i$ have no exact overlaps, then for every strictly positive probability vector $p$ their self-similar measure has $$\dim_H\mu=\min\left\{1,\frac{H(p)}{\log(1/\lambda)}\right\}.$$

Let $0<\lambda<1$ and $t\in\mathbb R$. If the indexed maps $$x\longmapsto\lambda x,\qquad

 =\min\left\{1,\frac{-\sum_{i=0}^2 p_i\log p_i}
